Name: Emily Doesn't Wear Lipstick
Author: untamedJester
Description:
[left]When I first started playing Stardew Valley years ago, I thought Emily wasn't wearing lipstick when I first saw her. Well, let's just say I was surprised when I found out her lips were bright red and it's always thrown me off ever since.[/left]
I've also never understood why her hair looks so fluffy in her sprite but her hair is so short in her portrait. 

This mod changes that. It makes her lips pink and adds a bit more hair in the portrait.

I did this originally for personal preference, but then I decided to go ahead and upload it, wondering if anyone else wasn't a fan of Emily's lipstick.
(I want to say that I have NO problems with lipstick or Emily's lips in the vanilla version of the game. I think she's gorgeous in every way shape or form. This is just my personal taste!)

How to download:
1. Download the file
2. Unzip the file
3. Drag and drop the unzipped file into your Stardew Valley mods folder

Manifest.Name: Emily Doesn't Wear Lipstick
Manifest.Description: Removes Emily's red lipstick and makes her lips pink
Manifest.Author: untamedJester
